# Matt Tengtrakool

> Founder & CEO of Givefront. Based in San Francisco.

## Contact

- Email: me@matthewtengtrakool.com
- Twitter: https://twitter.com/MattTtkool
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/matt-tengtrakool/
- Site: https://matthewtengtrakool.com

## Current

Givefront (https://givefront.com) is a financial platform that equips America's nonprofits with the same caliber of tools the private sector takes for granted. Backed by Y Combinator (W24) and Script Capital.

- TechCrunch: https://techcrunch.com/2025/12/18/these-21-year-old-dropouts-raised-2m-to-build-givefront-a-fintech-for-nonprofits/
- Y Combinator: https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/givefront

## Background

Born in Burlington, Massachusetts. Attended Harvard to study computer science and statistics. Left to build Givefront.

Previously: first engineering intern at Cherry (https://withcherry.com). Built Oban Market (https://oban.market), a loan comparison platform in Nigeria. Spent time at the USDA, Microsoft, and MIT Lincoln Lab. President of the Harvard Technology Review. Wrote for the Harvard Political Review.

## Interests

Progress studies, philosophy, Thoreau.

## Recognition

Nasdaq, Thoreau Scholar, Roddenberry Catalyst, ZFellow, KP Fellow, Footlocker National Scholar Athlete.
